question:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding rate of diffusion of liquids?

I. Rate of diffusion of liquids is higher than that of solids.

II. This is due to the fact that in the liquid state, particles move freely and have greater space between each other as compared to particles in the solid state.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rate of diffusion of liquids is higher than that of solids.
 
• This is due to the fact that in the liquid state, particles move freely and have greater space between each other as compared to particles in the solid state.
 
• Diffusion is the movement of particles from an area of higher concentration to an area of low
